verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled "Luma APIs Documentation"), and lumalabs.ai/llms.txt summarizes the API, models and pricing. Any docs page can be fetched as markdown by appending .md, and the current Agents API docs offer "Copy Markdown" and assistant-open links. Missing for 10: the probed docs llms.txt indexes the legacy-generation docs rather than the current Agents API docs, and there is no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
indexed by the docs llms.txt ("# Luma APIs Documentation")
